defects.summary: The approved MOD-029 run order (ADR-012, RULE-158) makes usp_run_daily_load call usp_load_silv_daily_count and usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail itself after usp_run_payment_segments. The MOD-023, MOD-024 and MOD-025 suites still stub only the bronze, silver and gold steps, so the real daily count and gold daily fact now run on their unseeded fakes and fail.
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Run the test_MOD023, test_MOD024 and test_MOD025 suites on commit 2b41575 (for example test_MOD023.[test TC-023-001 one daily run logs every segment load as Success under the daily run id]). The SetUp in tests/tsqlt/test_MOD023.sql spies Layercake.usp_load_bronze, usp_load_silver and usp_load_gold with stubs, but not usp_load_silv_daily_count or usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail. Its fakes leave dim_membership_grade empty. EXEC Layercake.usp_run_daily_load then fails in the gold daily fact. test_MOD024.sql line 47 and test_MOD025.sql line 105 use the same pattern.
defects.expected: DES-001 usp_run_daily_load (MOD-029) and MP-001 MOD-029 say the run goes: bronze; silver with @SkipDailyCount = 1; gold with @SkipDailyFact = 1; usp_run_payment_segments; usp_load_silv_daily_count; usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail. The earlier conditions check the segment loads in one daily run (REQ-021, RULE-123 to RULE-126). They should still pass once their setup takes these two direct calls into account, either by spying both procedures or by seeding dim_membership_grade and the daily tables. TC-023-013 should also check that @FullRebuild reaches the daily count step, as MP-001 MOD-029 asks the Tester to amend.
defects.actual: Each of these tests fails in usp_run_daily_load with: 'dim_membership_grade is missing the Candidate/Qualified members - run usp_load_dim_membership_grade (and deploy the baseline DDL) before this module.' (Layercake.usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail, line 85, severity 16). TC-023-007 gets this error on its second run, after the source row is corrected. Before MOD-029 the tests' usp_load_silver and usp_load_gold spies replaced the whole silver and gold steps, so the daily count and gold daily fact never ran. Now usp_run_daily_load calls them directly, outside the spied steps, as the design requires. All 20 MOD-029 tests pass, including TC-029-001, TC-029-014 and TC-029-019 for the new order, the FullRebuild routing and the fact contents.
